why: The server tests each idea at one setting chosen from the parameter budget alone. The laptop's GPU trains the delayed bed in about 25 minutes, so it screens a second setting of each idea at one seed, to show whether the verdict could turn on the setting.
device: the laptop's GPU (MPS), which differs from the server's GPUs, so the bed is run there too

arms.experts8-mps: eight groups of which four speak, --granule-experts 8 --granule-active 4 --granule-cells 1016 (5,242,880)

measure: Averaged validation in windows at 6,000 updates (64 batches), trained exactly as the server runs, seed 20001.
reading: A screen, not a verdict: one seed, where seeds of the bed span 0.021. A second setting at least 0.020 ahead of g6d-mps earns four seeds on the server under the four-seed mark; anything less is reported beside the server's verdict and decides nothing.
seen_before_recording: No run of any idea has reached its first evaluation on the server.
